Landing.heroTitle: Your whole life, in one terminal-shaped place
Landing.heroBody: Tasks, boards, career, habits, notes and money — keyboard-first, with an AI copilot that asks before it writes.
Landing.modulesBody: Each module is a small, focused tool, and they share one service layer — so the API and the copilot see exactly what you do.
Landing.moduleTasksBody: Kanban boards with natural-language capture, priorities, due dates and saved views.
Landing.moduleCareerBody: A job pipeline with stage history, a JSON Resume CV builder and interview prep.
Landing.moduleHabitsBody: Streaks with a heatmap and key results you can actually measure.
Landing.moduleNotesBody: Markdown notes with daily entries, tags and backlinks.
Landing.moduleFinanceBody: Manual accounts, budgets and subscriptions — no bank connections, no advice.
Landing.moduleCalendarBody: Month, week and agenda over every dated item, in your timezone.
Landing.aiTitle: An AI copilot that asks first
Landing.aiBody: Every write goes through an approval step, every tool is scoped to your account, and every call is audited.
Landing.dataBody: The same services power the web app, a REST API and an MCP server for your own agents — Claude, Cursor, a script, a Shortcut.
Landing.keyboardBody: Command palette, vim-style navigation, and a cheat-sheet generated from the keys that actually work.
Landing.stepsTitle: Up and running in a minute
Landing.step1Body: Or self-host the whole app — it runs from one container.
Landing.step2Body: Developer, student or freelancer templates, or start blank.
Landing.step3Body: Generate an API key and point Claude, Cursor or a script at the MCP server.
Landing.ctaBody: Free, open source, and yours to self-host.
Landing.footerNote: A free, open, AI-connected personal operating system.
Landing.productTitle: A real workspace, not a mock
Landing.productBody: This is the seeded workspace itself — the dashboard, and the task board with the day's brief already planned.
Landing.screenshotDashboardAlt: The LifeOS dashboard: a habit-consistency chart, KPI cards and habit streaks.
Landing.screenshotBoardAlt: The LifeOS task board: a plan-my-day brief, filter chips and kanban columns.
Landing.faqA1: Yes. It is free and open source, and the whole app runs from one container — you can self-host it without an account.
Landing.faqA2: In your own database, and nowhere else. You can export everything as JSON, per-module CSV and Markdown, or read it through the API.
Landing.faqQ3: Do I need an AI provider?
Landing.faqA3: No. Every module works without AI. Add a key in settings to switch on the copilot, and you choose the provider.
Landing.faqQ4: Can my own tools and agents use it?
Landing.faqA4: Yes. Create a scoped API key and use the REST API or the MCP server; /llms.txt and /llms-full.txt describe both for an agent.
Landing.faqA5: Next.js and TypeScript on SQLite (libSQL) with Drizzle, shadcn/ui and Recharts in the UI, and an MCP server over the same services.
